name: Giant Slayer
description: A greataxe whose blade is notched with a tally of kills.
body:
## What it does

Any axe or sword can carry this enchantment; this one is a greataxe. It strikes truer and harder than a plain one, and a giant it hits takes far more harm and must make a DC 15 Strength saving throw or fall prone.

damage.note: against a giant, which also falls prone unless it makes a DC 15 Strength save
